description: Source code implementing BLE platform integration for OpenThread on Zephyr RTOS, including BLE service setup, connection handling, message queuing, and interaction with OpenThread API.

methods.name: on_receive
methods.description: Callback invoked when data is written to the RX characteristic by a BLE client.

methods.name: on_cccd_changed
methods.description: Callback invoked when the Client Characteristic Configuration Descriptor (CCCD) is changed, indicating notification subscription status.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Callback invoked upon BLE connection establishment.

methods.name: le_param_req
methods.description: Callback to approve or reject connection parameter update requests.

methods.name: le_param_updated
methods.description: Callback invoked when BLE connection parameters are updated.

methods.name: otPlatBleGapAdvStart
methods.description: Starts BLE advertising for a given OpenThread instance.

methods.name: otPlatBleGapAdvStop
methods.description: Stops BLE advertising for a given OpenThread instance.

methods.name: otPlatBleEnable
methods.description: Enables BLE and initializes OpenThread BLE interface.

methods.name: otPlatBleDisable
methods.description: Disables BLE (no operation in current implementation).
